decision.research_rationale: Read full ORIGINAL:EO:7431, span 0–1475, and full ACTOR_TEXT:EO:7704, span 0–1488. The selected heading, Havenner's identity and position, closing number 7431 and August 17, 1936 signing line agree with the supplied metadata. The inventory contains one operative command: exemption from section 204 coupled with continuance until October 1, 1937. The quoted statute and the September 1936 retirement-age recital create no additional command or earlier ending. The exact operative ending span is TERM:EO:7431:0c79d3eb697345da@4ecbb4e43beb178d, 1276–1367, in selected text hash 4ecbb4e43beb178d3525c8a4ef77cc5c65cb3ebaf4c4f7a56ccb5401b1e91b7b. The fixed date ends the grant itself; it is not merely an upper bound on an unproved completion event. Earlier actual death, retirement or separation is not inferred from age or silence. Such an event could end actual employment, but the order contains no express condition making it an earlier legal termination of its fixed exemption. EO:7704, signed September 10, 1937, recites the prior exemption and independently exempts the same employee until October 1, 1938. It provides a continuation lead and a new legal grant, not proof of uninterrupted service or an amendment extending EO:7431's own term. The alternative extension theory is rejected because EO:7704 neither replaces EO:7431's date nor directs any textual change. Savings analysis distinguishes potentially accrued employment consequences from operative force. The supplied USC and eCFR citation searches show no hits, within their stated scope; the USC release omits enactments after October 9, 2026. OFR's pre-1937 limitation is expressly retained, and its one hit is examined through the supplied actor text. The held-text name search likewise reports one hit, examined as EO:7704; its 85 unheld census orders and parsing limitations prevent a claim of universal search completeness. Together these are adequate bounded counterevidence searches for this narrow fixed-term grant, not affirmative proof of personnel history or every conceivable legal development. Prior claim 518f99bbd89f57453afedbd76972a8c45c973a29bf2165f511847fafac440068 and its AI review were treated as qualified research context; this conclusion rests on the present exact sources. Producer approval is same-family AI production, not independent review or human certification.
